11866|f3b1497b.name: Ilyenia Moonfire
11866|f3b1497b.text: The grace with which I fight is not something I can teach you, but I can teach you the use of various weapons.

2080|ac9bd966.name: Denalan
2080|ac9bd966.text: The creation of Teldrassil was a grand achievement, but now the world must shift to regain its balance.

3306|0e051c59.name: Keldas
3306|0e051c59.text: You've come for training in order to pass it on to your pets?

3516|cc6cb2bd.name: Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm
3516|cc6cb2bd.text: Make it quick, $c. Observing and guiding the growth of Teldrassil leaves me with little time to waste to idle banter.

3567|8f79505e.name: Tallonkai Swiftroot
3567|8f79505e.text: Well met, $N. It is good to see that hunters like yourself are taking an active part in protecting the groves.

3601|497f7ea2.name: Dazalar
3601|497f7ea2.text: There are many places that you might visit in Teldrassil.  Tell me what you seek.

3605|08c2dba0.name: Nadyia Maneweaver
3605|08c2dba0.text: You need to make your stitches smaller, $N. Fewer items will slip out of your quivers and ammo pouches. Besides, no one likes a lumpy tunic.

3605|c7a4e3ad.name: Nadyia Maneweaver
3605|c7a4e3ad.text: Welcome to our home, $N. Radnaal and I have little to offer, but you are welcome to what hospitality we can provide.

4156|c2467ddc.name: Astaia
4156|c2467ddc.text: I can teach you fishing skills.

4210|0c543544.name: Alegorn
4210|0c543544.text: Cooking is a life long pursuit and I see we share the same passion!

4241|b0e0696e.name: Mydrannul
4241|b0e0696e.text: It is my honor to provide for adventurers, for they are heroes in the making.

6094|a28d29e1.name: Byancie
6094|a28d29e1.text: I can train you in First Aid techniques.

6286|f842f7e5.name: Zarrin
6286|f842f7e5.text: Hello, $N. If you'd like to learn a thing or two about cooking, please visit me at any time.

6491|22357dc5.name: Spirit Healer
6491|22357dc5.text: It is not yet your time. I shall aid your journey back to the realm of the living... for a price.

2399-complete.name: Unknown
2399-complete.text: The fronds Denalan planted within his garden have sprouted and grown.  They tremble, eager to be picked....
2399-complete.title: The Sprouted Fronds

2459-complete.name: Tallonkai Swiftroot
2459-complete.text: Now I can repair my dreamcatcher.  Thank you, $N.
2459-complete.title: Ferocitas the Dream Eater

2459-progress.name: Tallonkai Swiftroot
2459-progress.text: Ferocitas and the Gnarlpine mystics must return what is mine.  Please retrieve the emerald so that I may repair my emerald dreamcatcher.
2459-progress.title: Ferocitas the Dream Eater

2498-accept.name: Rellian Greenspyre
2498-accept.text:
I have just received word that  Denalan at Lake Al'Ameth has discovered what may be the cause of the tumors that plague the timberlings. Please speak with him, and tell him I sent you.

Make haste, $N; he needs our help.
2498-accept.title: Return to Denalan

2518-accept.name: Priestess A'moora
2518-accept.text:
Lady Sathrah was once beloved of Elune. Graceful and pure, the spider spun her silver threads through the moonlight, catching the evening mist. The silvery dew had strong healing powers and was kept here in the temple.

But of late, Sathrah has descended into madness. Her future generations are now threatened as well.

Find Lady Sathrah, $N, and end her suffering. She dwells along the northern borders of Teldrassil, near Wellspring Lake. Gather her silvery spinnerets and bring them back to me.
2518-accept.title: Tears of the Moon

2518-complete.name: Priestess A'moora
2518-complete.text:
The forest mourns for Lady Sathrah, but it was something that had to be done.

Thank you, $N.
2518-complete.title: Tears of the Moon

2518-progress.name: Priestess A'moora
2518-progress.text:
I regret the task that I have asked you to carry out; but Lady Sathrah is beyond hope.

It is our hope to offer the sacrifice of the spinnerets to Elune. With this sacrifice, Elune will bless Sathrah so that she might be reborn, and at peace.
2518-progress.title: Tears of the Moon

2520-accept.name: Priestess A'moora
2520-accept.text:
Now you must finish the task to which you have been appointed. Take the spinnerets and offer Lady Sathrah's sacrifice to Elune; lay the great spider to rest.

Inside this temple, find the central fountain. There is where you may leave the sacrifice.  The holy waters will purify and cleanse the corruption that drove Sathrah mad.

When you have completed this, return to me.
2520-accept.title: Sathrah's Sacrifice

2520-complete.name: Priestess A'moora
2520-complete.text:
The loss of Lady Sathrah is distressing, but in this way only may she be reborn with a renewed spirit.

May Elune willingly accept the sacrifice that you have offered her.
2520-complete.title: Sathrah's Sacrifice

487-accept.name: Moon Priestess Amara
487-accept.text:
The road to Darnassus must be kept safe.  Travelers heading from Dolanaar to Darnassus have been reporting ruthless attacks by corrupted furbolgs from the Gnarlpine tribe.

Important news and commerce travels to and from Darnassus by way of this road daily.  We cannot afford to have a rogue band of heathens terrorizing people.

Take up arms in the name of the sacred forest, $c.  Their den lies somewhere below this vantage point.  Slay 6 of these Gnarlpine ambushers and report back to me.
487-accept.title: The Road to Darnassus

487-complete.name: Moon Priestess Amara
487-complete.text: You have served the good people of Dolanaar and Darnassus well, brave $c.  As a member of the Sentinel force of Teldrassil I salute your efforts.
487-complete.title: The Road to Darnassus

487-progress.name: Moon Priestess Amara
487-progress.text: The road is still not safe, $c. Travel forth and slay 6 Gnarlpine Ambushers and return to me.
487-progress.title: The Road to Darnassus

489-complete.name: Zenn Foulhoof
489-complete.text: Ah, what a sweet $r!  I knew you would come in handy!
489-complete.title: Seek Redemption!

489-progress.name: Zenn Foulhoof
489-progress.text: What do you have for me, $N?  A lovely snack I presume?
489-progress.title: Seek Redemption!

6063-accept.name: Dazalar
6063-accept.text:
As a $c, it is important to remember the responsibility you hold in your hands. Nature is not a power that can be bent to obey our desires; it is one that is to be respected and acknowledged as something stronger than your very existence.

$N, you must prove your understanding of this before you will gain the ability to tame an animal to be your companion.

Your first task is to take this taming rod. With it, you will be able to tame a webwood lurker. Tame it, and practice your skills as a $c.
6063-accept.title: Taming the Beast

6063-complete.name: Dazalar
6063-complete.text: Excellent, $N! You are quite a fast learner.
6063-complete.title: Taming the Beast

6063-progress.name: Dazalar
6063-progress.text: You will learn, $N, and one day you will be a great $c.
6063-progress.title: Taming the Beast

6101-accept.name: Dazalar
6101-accept.text:
The variance of nature is something that can be relied upon, $N. It is predictable in the way that it never remains the same; it is always changing.

The tasks I give to you will help you to see and appreciate the vast differences of the creatures you may choose as your companion.

Take this taming rod and use it to tame a nightsaber stalker, found to the south. Practice your skills as a $c. Then you will begin to understand the similarities and differences of nature.
6101-accept.title: Taming the Beast

6101-complete.name: Dazalar
6101-complete.text: I see your commitment and that you have understood what I have taught you, $N.
6101-complete.title: Taming the Beast

6101-progress.name: Dazalar
6101-progress.text: Understanding the balance between nature and oneself is a way of life for every $r.
6101-progress.title: Taming the Beast

6102-accept.name: Dazalar
6102-accept.text:
You have tamed two creatures that inhabit the land, now you must tame one that soars the skies. Use the taming rod to tame a strigid screecher, found west of here. Practice your skills with this mighty owl at your side.

When you return, I will bestow you with the skills you will need to tame an animal of your choosing to be your companion; this creature will face the challenges you face, and gain experience alongside you. I will also show you how to call it and dismiss it as you wish.
6102-accept.title: Taming the Beast

6102-complete.name: Dazalar
6102-complete.text:
You have learned all I can teach you, $N. May I offer you one more piece of advice: use discretion when choosing your first pet. Will you choose a creature of the land, of the water, or of the sky? Whatever it may be, without doubt, your pet will be with you for quite some time.

Here you are, $N. I will now give you the power to tame a beast, as well as call it and dismiss it as you see fit. Use your new skills with pride; you have earned them.
6102-complete.title: Taming the Beast

6102-progress.name: Dazalar
6102-progress.text: I am proud of your accomplishments, $N. Have you finished the last task I gave you?
6102-progress.title: Taming the Beast

6103-accept.name: Dazalar
6103-accept.text:
You now have the power to tame a pet, but you must also gain the skills to train it.

Travel to Darnassus. There you must speak to one of our most revered hunters, Jocaste. She will give you the ability to train your new pet, so make haste.

While Jocaste may seem stern, she is always pleased to see another $c rising through the ranks. Treat her with respect and she will return in kind. Good luck, $N.
6103-accept.title: Training the Beast

6103-complete.name: Jocaste
6103-complete.text:
A fledgling $c, I see. Yes, I can bestow you with the skills you need to train and guide your pet. Not only will you be able to teach your pet new abilities, you will now be able to feed your pet, as well as revive it, should it fall in battle.

Remember, $N, always respect the balance and live in awe of nature around you. Now, go forth. We shall speak again, at a later date.
6103-complete.title: Training the Beast

6344-accept.name: Mydrannul
6344-accept.text:
A friend of mine, Nessa Shadowsong, is a fishing merchant in Rut'theran Village.  She needs a parcel taken to Darkshore, and is looking for someone to help her.

If you're interested, then to reach Nessa you must take the portal in Darnassus to Rut'theran Village.  You will find the portal west of the Temple Gardens.
6344-accept.title: Nessa Shadowsong

7383-accept.name: Corithras Moonrage
7383-accept.text:
All was not well with Teldrassil, however. Staghelm's carefully made plans for the new World Tree had borne out as he had hoped, but there was one small problem, a problem to which many of the troubles on Teldrassil may be attributed.

However, I will not get into that yet. You must visit the last moonwell, to the northwest in the Oracle Glade. Under the boughs of the Oracle Tree lies the first and most powerful of our wells. Retrieve a phial of its water and return to me.
7383-accept.title: Crown of the Earth

7383-complete.name: Corithras Moonrage
7383-complete.text:
To be in the presence of the Oracle Tree... it is almost to feel wisdom take form. Let me continue the telling...

With Teldrassil grown, the Arch Druid approached the dragons for their blessings, as the dragons had placed upon Nordrassil in ancient times. But Nozdormu, Lord of Time, refused to give his blessing, chiding the druid for his arrogance. In agreement with Nozdormu, Alexstrasza also refused Staghelm, and without her blessing, Teldrassil's growth has been flawed and unpredictable...
7383-complete.title: Crown of the Earth

7383-progress.name: Corithras Moonrage
7383-progress.text: Along with the druids, the Oracle Tree and the Arch Druid have been carefully monitoring the growth of Teldrassil. But though we have a new home, our immortal lives have not been restored.
7383-progress.title: Crown of the Earth

922-complete.name: Rellian Greenspyre
922-complete.text:
Ah, a timberling seed?  I wanted to try growing one of these to help Denalan with his studies.

But I'm afraid I've discovered that a corruption has grown in many of the timberlings, and seeds from such creatures carry their parent's taint.  They are beyond my talents to repair.

Denalan is very skilled with things that grow.  He may find a cure for future timberlings.  He may be their only hope.
922-complete.title: Rellian Greenspyre

922-progress.name: Rellian Greenspyre
922-progress.text:
Hello...

And how may I help you?
922-progress.title: Rellian Greenspyre

923-accept.name: Rellian Greenspyre
923-accept.text:
There is a malevolence growing in the timberlings.  We are trying to find the source, but until we do...in order to keep Teldrassil safe we must cut down the timberlings who are beyond help.  Those that wander Wellspring Lake in northern Teldrassil are the most tainted.  They must be removed!

Destroy the Timberlings you find there, and gather the mossy tumors growing upon them.  Bring the tumors to me so that they may be burned.
923-accept.title: Tumors

923-complete.name: Rellian Greenspyre
923-complete.text:
Well done!  These tumors are the symptom of the timberling's disease.  They are filled with a poison that we must cleanse from our new land.

I will dispose of these tumors.  Thank you, $N.
923-complete.title: Tumors

923-progress.name: Rellian Greenspyre
923-progress.text: Have you been to Wellspring Lake, $N?  Have you been hunting the timberlings there?
923-progress.title: Tumors

929-complete.name: Corithras Moonrage
929-complete.text:
After the Battle of Mount Hyjal, we were without direction. Nordrassil smoked from the fire it unleashed, and our immortality--the very essence of our beings!--was lost.

It was in this trying time that the Betrayer was freed from his prison, and Shan'do Stormrage disappeared. A dark time for all.
929-complete.title: Crown of the Earth

929-progress.name: Corithras Moonrage
929-progress.text: Hello again, $N. Have you completed your task?
929-progress.title: Crown of the Earth

930-accept.name: Unknown
930-accept.text:
Hanging from beneath its fronds of this glowing plant is a large, round fruit.

Denalan would want to study this fruit, you are certain.
930-accept.title: The Glowing Fruit

930-complete.name: Denalan
930-complete.text:
You found this on Teldrassil?  Intriguing... this fruit is exotic.  Perhaps its seeds were brought here from far off.  Perhaps even as far as Azeroth!  And there's something about this fruit... it seems to have reacted very strangely with the soil of Teldrassil.

Thank you, $N.  Now if you'll excuse me, I must study this further...
930-complete.title: The Glowing Fruit

930-progress.name: Denalan
930-progress.text: $N, you look like you have something to tell me.  Do you have news concerning the timberlings?
930-progress.title: The Glowing Fruit

931-accept.name: Unknown
931-accept.text:
The fronds on this plant shimmer in the forest light, giving it a twisting, pulsing aura.

You believe that Denalan would want a specimen of this.
931-accept.title: The Shimmering Frond

931-complete.name: Denalan
931-complete.text:
Where did you get this?  I haven't seen a plant like this since a sojourn I made to the Swamp of Sorrows... decades ago!  It's amazing that a specimen made its way to Teldrassil.  And it's grown to such a size!

Thank you, $N.  Forgive my shortness of words, but there is a test I would like to perform on this frond...
931-complete.title: The Shimmering Frond

932-complete.name: Tallonkai Swiftroot
932-complete.text: With Lord Melenas laid to rest I can finally move on to other matters. Thank you, $N.
932-complete.title: Twisted Hatred

932-progress.name: Tallonkai Swiftroot
932-progress.text: Did you kill Lord Melenas yet? It is vital that he be taken care of quickly and quietly, $N. His continued existence is an embarrassment to us all.
932-progress.title: Twisted Hatred

933-accept.name: Corithras Moonrage
933-accept.text:
There is another moonwell southeast of the entrance to Darnassus, on the shores of the Pools of Arlithrien. The Sentinels are having problems patrolling the area because of attacks and the growing ill-temperedness of the Gnarlpine furbolgs.

Be wary as you seek out the well, and keep your weapons close at hand.
933-accept.title: Crown of the Earth

933-complete.name: Corithras Moonrage
933-complete.text:
Shan'do Stormrage never returned, and the druids were in disarray, and to this day we still do not know what became of him. With Malfurion missing, Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm took over the leadership of the druids, convincing the Circle of Ancients in Darkshore that it was time for our people to rebuild, and that it was time for our people to regain their immortality.

With the approval of the Circle, Staghelm and the most powerful druids grew Teldrassil, the new World Tree.
933-complete.title: Crown of the Earth

933-progress.name: Corithras Moonrage
933-progress.text: At first the reports of crazed furbolg attacks were dismissed. Who could have thought that the peace-loving bear-men would turn to mindless rage? Yet another of the problems that plagues us here in our new home.
933-progress.title: Crown of the Earth

935-accept.name: Corithras Moonrage
935-accept.text:
Without the blessings of Alexstrasza the Life-Binder and Nozdormu the Timeless, Teldrassil's growth has not been without flaw. Strange beasts have been reported arising from the very ground of the tree, and crazed furbolgs attack passing travelers.

I can only hope that the solution the Arch Druid is looking for will be found quickly. I will pour all the phials you brought into this vessel, for you to deliver to Darnassus.

Bring it to Fandral Staghelm, you will find him in the druid grove.
935-accept.title: Crown of the Earth

935-complete.name: Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm
935-complete.text:
Ah yes, the water I had requested. Tenaron and Corithras certainly took their time in having it delivered... perhaps not choosing the most reliable of messengers... hmm.

Nonetheless, I can finally get back to my work then. The weight of Teldrassil's problems fall upon my shoulders. A yoke I would wish to soon be rid of.

Take this, you may find some use for it.
935-complete.title: Crown of the Earth

935-progress.name: Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm
935-progress.text:
I know that I did not summon you, so I cannot help but wonder why it is you have come to speak with me.

Whatever it is, please make it quick.
935-progress.title: Crown of the Earth

937-accept.name: Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak
937-accept.text:
I was dispatched with a small group of Sentinels here to protect the Oracle Tree from the harpies that have made nests all around the glade. Little by little we are trying to push them back.

When the Oracle Tree attempted to send a runner to Darnassus with a report, the messenger was attacked and killed by a group of the harpies.

If you feel up to the task, go to their nests, slay them, and return their belts to me as proof of your deeds.
937-accept.title: The Enchanted Glade

937-complete.name: Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak
937-complete.text: Thank you for your aid so far--it has been of great relief. Let me inspect these belts to see if we can glean any insights as to the harpy aggression.
937-complete.title: The Enchanted Glade

937-progress.name: Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak
937-progress.text: Their slashing talons and piercing beaks may prove a difficult match for your own abilities, $N, but I have faith that you will not fail in this task.
937-progress.title: The Enchanted Glade

940-accept.name: Unknown
940-accept.text:
The forest whispers of your feats of valor, $N. As I felt the harpies forced from their nests, a greater calm spread across the forest, its creatures once again feeling safe. I have feared sending another messenger to the Arch Druid, but I know that you will see my message safely to him.

Deliver this to him and know that the forest will see you safely along its paths to the forest of stone.
940-accept.title: Teldrassil

940-complete.name: Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm
940-complete.text:
I wondered why the Oracle Tree had not communicated with me for so long... It seems that some problems are lessened while others grow to greater concerns.

I fear my work on Teldrassil shall never be completed, and our immortality never restored.

Nonetheless, you have done the Oracle Tree's task well, and should be rewarded for your diligence.
940-complete.title: Teldrassil

940-progress.name: Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm
940-progress.text: Hmm... You come with the spirit of the forest strongly within you, $c. What business do you have with the Arch Druid of the Kaldorei?
940-progress.title: Teldrassil

952-accept.name: Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm
952-accept.text:
If you had enough time to run messages for the Oracle Tree, then I'm sure that I can press you into service to deliver a message to the Grove of the Ancients in Darkshore, due south of Auberdine.

You will most likely have to secure transport on a hippogryph, but I have faith enough in you that you can manage that. Take this to Onu, the Ancient of Lore. He has been awaiting word from me, even as I waited for news from the Oracle Glade.
952-accept.title: Grove of the Ancients

96634-complete.name: Zarrin
96634-complete.text:
With this, you'll be able to set up a camp anywhere out in the wilderness. What you've learned is just the basics, so you won't be able to place too many furnishings around it.

Raise your cooking skill and you might just be able to learn to make even bigger fires.

You can also learn the basics of furnishing your campsites from other tradeskill trainers if you're savvy in their skills.
96634-complete.title: Camping 101: Cooking

97942-complete.name: Byancie
97942-complete.text:
There you have it, you can now craft your very own First Aid Kit. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
97942-complete.title: Camping 101: First Aid

97949-complete.name: Radnaal Maneweaver
97949-complete.text:
There you have it, you can now craft your very own Camp Chair. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
97949-complete.title: Camping 101: Skinning

98067-accept.name: Sentinel Dalia Sunblade
98067-accept.text:
General Feathermoon ensures all sentinels have time to pray to Elune. A proper huntress wields not blade alone, but gifts of the goddess to overcome our enemies.

You may help with my daily duties. Place sentinels around the city--start with the tunnels leading beneath Cenarion Hold to the north, the bank at the center of town, the inn in the Craftsman's Terrace to the northeast, and the city gates. The guards can assist you.

Something is amiss in Teldrassil--we must remain vigilant.
98067-accept.title: Eyes of the Sentinels

98067-complete.name: Sentinel Dalia Sunblade
98067-complete.text: I thank you for your aid. Though I find peace in the daily rituals, it is nice to have a moment to reflect instead.
98067-complete.title: Eyes of the Sentinels

98392-accept.name: Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak
98392-accept.text:
These belts... look closely at the leather, $N. Do you see the taint running through the fibers?

I have a suspicion as to its origin, but we will need further proof to be sure.

Venture back out into the harpies' nests to the west and take out their leaders. If their necklaces carry the same darkness as these belts, we'll have our answer.
98392-accept.title: Darkness in the Glade

98392-complete.name: Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak
98392-complete.text:
<Arynia investigates the amulets.>

Do you see the foul green swirls within the gems? This is indeed fel moss corruption at work.

I have heard similar reports from Shadowglen and elsewhere in the boughs of this substance turning our very world against us.

I will inform my superiors of this at once.
98392-complete.title: Darkness in the Glade

98392-progress.name: Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak
98392-progress.text: Have you wrested the amulets from the harpies' leaders?
98392-progress.title: Darkness in the Glade

98398-accept.name: Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak
98398-accept.text:
I am impressed by what you have accomplished here in so short a time, $N. Would that I could ask you to remain here to assist me with my duties... but I know in my heart that greater tasks lie ahead for you.

I have noticed the Oracle Tree has just shed a piece of its bark. No doubt it has a task that it wishes completed. You should speak with it.
98398-accept.title: The Oracle Tree

98398-complete.name: Unknown
98398-complete.text: As you inspect the fallen bark, a voice enters your mind. It is calm and soothing, cresting over you like a gentle breeze through the leaves.
98398-complete.title: The Oracle Tree

98403-accept.name: Tallonkai Swiftroot
98403-accept.text:
Lord Melenas did not act alone; he was at the behest of another. The one you seek is Xethorr the Wicked. It seems he has twisted the spiders that call Teldrassil home, intending their venom for some foul plan.

He has taken residence deep in the forest, in the area to the northwest of here known as the Cleft. Take caution, and bring allies, for Xethorr is not an opponent to be trifled with.

Dispatch his brood, and bring me anything that may tell us more of the satyr's work here.
98403-accept.title: Twisted Hatred

99046-complete.name: Sentinel Eralya Leafshadow
99046-complete.text: Elune's grace... I shall not die... alone...
99046-complete.title: The Lost Runner

99047-accept.name: Sentinel Eralya Leafshadow
99047-accept.text:
My sisters and I... were dispatched... Oracle Tree...

Tree... message. I... harpies... everywhere...

<Eralya coughs up blood, grimacing through the pain.>

I may not have long... no one coming. Please... Byancie... in Dolanaar...
99047-accept.title: Not Dead Yet

99047-complete.name: Byancie
99047-complete.text:
The harpies have become afflicted by the same foulness showing up throughout the forest. I'm sure that is what ails Sentinel Eralya as well.

We must hurry. It won't be long before she succumbs to her injuries.
99047-complete.title: Not Dead Yet

99050-accept.name: Byancie
99050-accept.text:
I will need your help acquiring the ingredients I need to stop the affliction long enough for Eralya to make it back here for further treatment.

Thankfully, our living home is still bountiful and will provide in our time of need.

The core ingredient is dewy lasher fronds. You'll find them around Lake Al'Ameth directly south of here, or Wellspring Lake and its river to the northwest.

In addition, I'll need an empty vial and some spring water. Both can be bought here in town, or traded for.
99050-accept.title: The Great Tree Provides

99050-complete.name: Byancie
99050-complete.text:
Thank you for your help. Please, accept this to help with the costs of the vial and water.

Now, to make the salve. It should only take a moment.
99050-complete.title: The Great Tree Provides

99050-progress.name: Byancie
99050-progress.text: Do you have the ingredients? I fear Eralya may not have long.
99050-progress.title: The Great Tree Provides
